answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 22335 Country: Pakistan Title: my name is Muhammad Asif Mehmood I have a son, his name is Abdul Rafay, now Allah blessed me with a daughter and i want to give her islamic name please advise. Question: Assalam O Alaikum my name is Muhammad Asif Mehmood I have a son, his name is Abdul Rafay, now Allah blessed me with a daughter and i want to give her islamic name please advise. Jazak ALLAH... Answer ID: 22335 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 791/791/M=1431) Please pick up any name from the following names for your daughter: Ruqayya , Haleema , Sadia , Safi y ya , Zainab , Habeeba , and Afeefa . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
